draft: If you dug where we met, we could not tell you what you would find [[alx.limit.material-remains]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Our own writings describe souls and books far more than rooms and walls [[alx.limit.material-remains]] [[as:paraphrase]]. The city was rebuilt age after age, and much of the old shore lies under the sea [[alx.limit.material-remains]] [[as:paraphrase]]. For us the ekklesia was not a building or a list of members, but the assembly gathered around the Logos who calls it [[alx.term.ekklesia]] [[as:paraphrase]]. What we shared was the eucharistia, the thanksgiving meal of bread and cup at the heart of worship, open to members whether or not they could read [[alx.term.eucharistia]] [[as:paraphrase]].
